PCE.description:
Parameter Catalog and Evaluation

The named calculation parameters an analysis resolves through: their owner
class, unit, data type, frame dependency and per-publisher availability
(CATALOG), a request and result for evaluating named parameters on states
at epochs in a stated coordinate system (EVALUATION_REQUEST /
EVALUATION_RESULT), and propagate-to-condition, which is a predicate on one
of those same names rather than a vocabulary of its own (STOP_REQUEST /
STOP_REPORT). Stopping conditions, targeting goals, report columns and plot
series all resolve names here, so a name means one thing everywhere.

Angles are radians, lengths metres, durations seconds, masses kilograms.
A buffer carries the members its exchange needs; a catalog publication and
an evaluation exchange are both complete $PCE records.

BUS_ID.description:
Join key to the BUS record describing this object's satellite bus; holds
that record's BUS.ID verbatim. MANUFACTURER, DIM_X/DIM_Y/DIM_Z, DRY_MASS
and WET_MASS are properties of the bus design and live on BUS — they are
NOT duplicated here. Empty when the bus is unknown.

CATALOG_URI.description:
Absolute URI identifying the original catalog's object-ID namespace.
This is an identifier, not an instruction to fetch a resource. Use with
CATALOG_OBJECT_ID only when both fields are present. Preserve the pair
through replicas and derived catalogs; it does not assert a NORAD or
COSPAR association. If the authority can reassign an object ID, this URI
must identify its immutable edition or assignment interval, rather than
the unversioned catalog. Stable IDs may use a persistent catalog URI.

CATALOG_OBJECT_ID.description:
Exact, opaque object identifier assigned by CATALOG_URI's authority.
Preserve case, Unicode and leading zeros. Numeric-looking native IDs
are not NORAD_CAT_ID values. Neither a matching name nor a native ID
in a different namespace establishes that two records describe the same
physical object. Publication provenance retains source and edition data.

PPEPositionRecord.description:
A single time-segment record of polynomial coefficients for Cartesian position
(and optionally velocity). Coefficients are stored per axis.

To evaluate position at time t within this record's validity window:
1. Compute normalized time: tau = (t - EPOCH_MID) / EPOCH_HALF_SPAN
where tau is in [-1, +1].
2. Evaluate the polynomial basis of degree (NUM_COEFFICIENTS - 1) using
the coefficients for each axis.

Velocity coefficients, if present, follow the same evaluation procedure.
If HAS_VELOCITY_COEFFICIENTS is false, velocity can be obtained by
analytically differentiating the position polynomial.

EPOCH_MID.description:
Midpoint epoch of this record's validity window (ISO 8601 UTC or TDB).
Together with EPOCH_HALF_SPAN, defines the time interval:
[EPOCH_MID - EPOCH_HALF_SPAN, EPOCH_MID + EPOCH_HALF_SPAN]

EPOCH_HALF_SPAN.description:
Half-span of the validity window in seconds.
The full span is 2 * EPOCH_HALF_SPAN seconds centered on EPOCH_MID.

NUM_COEFFICIENTS.description:
Number of polynomial coefficients per axis.
The polynomial degree is (NUM_COEFFICIENTS - 1).
Typical values: 8-32 for high-fidelity ephemeris fits.

BASIS_TYPE.description: Polynomial basis type for interpreting the coefficient arrays.

CHEBYSHEV.description: Chebyshev polynomials of the first kind T_n(x). Most common for ephemeris fitting due to minimax approximation properties.

LEGENDRE.description: Legendre polynomials P_n(x). Orthogonal on [-1, 1] with unit weight function.

HERMITE.description: Hermite interpolating polynomials. Matches both function values and derivatives at nodes.

LAGRANGE.description: Lagrange interpolating polynomials. Exact interpolation through specified nodes.

POWER_SERIES.description: Standard power series (monomial basis): c0 + c1*x + c2*x^2 + ...

POS_COEFF_X.description:
Position coefficients for X-axis (km).
Length must equal NUM_COEFFICIENTS. Ordered c0, c1, ..., c_{N-1}.

POS_COEFF_Y.description:
Position coefficients for Y-axis (km).
Length must equal NUM_COEFFICIENTS.

POS_COEFF_Z.description:
Position coefficients for Z-axis (km).
Length must equal NUM_COEFFICIENTS.

HAS_VELOCITY_COEFFICIENTS.description:
Whether explicit velocity coefficients are provided.
If false, velocity should be derived by differentiating the position polynomial.

VEL_COEFF_X.description:
Velocity coefficients for X-axis (km/s). Optional.
Length must equal NUM_COEFFICIENTS if present.

MAX_POSITION_RESIDUAL.description: Maximum position fit residual over this segment (km). Optional quality metric.

RMS_POSITION_RESIDUAL.description: RMS position fit residual over this segment (km). Optional quality metric.

PPEOrbitalElementRecord.description:
A single time-segment record of polynomial coefficients for classical orbital elements.

The six classical elements are:
1. SMA or R_PERIAPSIS (size/shape) — see SIZE_SHAPE_TYPE
2. Eccentricity (dimensionless)
3. Inclination (degrees)
4. Right Ascension of Ascending Node / RAAN (degrees)
5. Argument of Periapsis (degrees)
6. Anomaly (degrees) — see ANOMALY_TYPE

Evaluation follows the same normalized-time procedure as PPEPositionRecord.

EPOCH_MID.description: Midpoint epoch of this record's validity window (ISO 8601 UTC or TDB).

EPOCH_HALF_SPAN.description: Half-span of the validity window in seconds.

NUM_COEFFICIENTS.description: Number of polynomial coefficients per element.

BASIS_TYPE.description: Polynomial basis type for interpreting the coefficient arrays.

CHEBYSHEV.description: Chebyshev polynomials of the first kind T_n(x). Most common for ephemeris fitting due to minimax approximation properties.

LEGENDRE.description: Legendre polynomials P_n(x). Orthogonal on [-1, 1] with unit weight function.

HERMITE.description: Hermite interpolating polynomials. Matches both function values and derivatives at nodes.

LAGRANGE.description: Lagrange interpolating polynomials. Exact interpolation through specified nodes.

POWER_SERIES.description: Standard power series (monomial basis): c0 + c1*x + c2*x^2 + ...

SIZE_SHAPE_TYPE.description: Parameterization of the first orbital element (SMA vs R_PERIAPSIS).

SMA.description: Semi-major axis (km). Standard for elliptical orbits.

R_PERIAPSIS.description: Radius of periapsis (km). Preferred for hyperbolic orbits.

ANOMALY_TYPE.description: Anomaly type for the sixth orbital element.

MEAN_ANOMALY.description: Mean anomaly (linear in time for Keplerian motion).

ECCENTRIC_ANOMALY.description: Eccentric anomaly (auxiliary angle in the Kepler equation).

COEFF_SIZE_SHAPE.description:
Coefficients for SMA or radius of periapsis (km).
Length must equal NUM_COEFFICIENTS.

COEFF_ECCENTRICITY.description:
Coefficients for eccentricity (dimensionless).
Length must equal NUM_COEFFICIENTS.

COEFF_INCLINATION.description:
Coefficients for inclination (degrees).
Length must equal NUM_COEFFICIENTS.

COEFF_RAAN.description:
Coefficients for RAAN (degrees).
Length must equal NUM_COEFFICIENTS.

COEFF_ARG_PERIAPSIS.description:
Coefficients for argument of periapsis (degrees).
Length must equal NUM_COEFFICIENTS.

COEFF_ANOMALY.description:
Coefficients for anomaly (degrees). See ANOMALY_TYPE for interpretation.
Length must equal NUM_COEFFICIENTS.

MAX_ELEMENT_RESIDUAL.description:
Maximum element fit residual over this segment. Optional quality metric.
Units depend on the element (km for SMA, degrees for angles, dimensionless for ecc).

RMS_ELEMENT_RESIDUAL.description: RMS element fit residual over this segment. Optional quality metric.

PPE.description:
Polynomial Ephemeris — top-level message containing metadata and
one or more polynomial coefficient records for a single space object.

A PPE message may contain position records, orbital element records, or both.
Records should be ordered chronologically by EPOCH_MID and should collectively
cover the time span [START_TIME, STOP_TIME] without gaps.

CENTER_NAME.description: Origin of the reference frame (e.g., EARTH, MOON, MARS).

TIME_SYSTEM.description: Time system used for all epochs in this message.

SCLK.description: Spacecraft Clock (receiver) (requires rules for interpretation in ICD)

A1.description: Atomic time scale of the reference atomic-time network, offset from International Atomic Time by the fixed constant A1 - TAI = 0.0343817 s exactly. Appended last; never reorder or reuse existing values.

START_TIME.description: Start of the total time span covered by this ephemeris (ISO 8601).

STOP_TIME.description: End of the total time span covered by this ephemeris (ISO 8601).

DEFAULT_BASIS_TYPE.description:
Default polynomial basis type for all records in this message.
Individual records may override this with their own BASIS_TYPE field.

CHEBYSHEV.description: Chebyshev polynomials of the first kind T_n(x). Most common for ephemeris fitting due to minimax approximation properties.

LEGENDRE.description: Legendre polynomials P_n(x). Orthogonal on [-1, 1] with unit weight function.

HERMITE.description: Hermite interpolating polynomials. Matches both function values and derivatives at nodes.

LAGRANGE.description: Lagrange interpolating polynomials. Exact interpolation through specified nodes.

POWER_SERIES.description: Standard power series (monomial basis): c0 + c1*x + c2*x^2 + ...

POSITION_RECORDS.description:
Array of position polynomial records.
Each record covers a time segment; together they span [START_TIME, STOP_TIME].

ORBITAL_ELEMENT_RECORDS.description:
Array of orbital element polynomial records.
Each record covers a time segment; together they span [START_TIME, STOP_TIME].

EPHEMERIS_SOURCE.description:
Generating ephemeris source, verbatim as the generator names itself
(e.g., a planetary ephemeris series designation, a numerical propagator
name and version, or an in-house tool identifier).

NOMINAL_SEGMENT_SPAN.description:
Fit span in seconds used to generate each polynomial segment.
Informational; actual spans are in individual records.

NOMINAL_NUM_COEFFICIENTS.description:
Nominal number of coefficients per segment.
Informational; actual counts are in individual records.

NCDSegmentDescriptor.description:
One independently addressed segment inside a native container.

A segmented binary ephemeris is not a single span: each segment has its own
body pair, frame, numeric type and time bounds, and a reader must choose
among them. $OEM carries the STATES; this carries the segment DESCRIPTOR
that says which states came from where and what must be written back.

NAME.description: Segment name as recorded in the container.

TARGET_NAIF_ID.description: Integer body code of the segment target.

CENTER_NAIF_ID.description: Integer body code of the segment centre.

FRAME_NAIF_ID.description: Integer reference frame code of the segment.

FRAME_NAME.description: Reference frame name as recorded in the container.

SEGMENT_TYPE.description:
Numeric segment data type, verbatim. The evaluation rule is a property of
this number (for example, Chebyshev position with fixed interval, or
discrete states with Lagrange interpolation); it is carried as the
container's own integer so a rewrite is exact.

START_SECONDS_PAST_J2000_TDB.description:
Segment coverage start, seconds past J2000 in the barycentric dynamical
time scale, as stored in the container.

INITIAL_ADDRESS.description: First addressed element of the segment inside the file.

FINAL_ADDRESS.description: Last addressed element of the segment inside the file.

POLYNOMIAL_DEGREE.description:
Polynomial degree or record size the segment type parameterises, when the
type carries one.

NCDSP3Header.description: Header block of a fixed-column satellite position container (SP3).

FILE_TYPE.description:
Record content indicator, e.g. "P" for positions only, "V" with
velocities.

SATELLITE_SYSTEM.description: Satellite system indicator recorded in the header.

ORBIT_TYPE.description: Orbit type as recorded, e.g. fitted, extrapolated, broadcast, helmert.

DATA_USED.description: Data used to produce the file, as recorded.

COORDINATE_SYSTEM.description: Terrestrial reference frame name as recorded.

AGENCY.description:
Producing agency as recorded IN THE FILE. This is observed content, not a
classification.

TIME_SYSTEM.description: Time system as recorded in the header.

GPS_WEEK.description: Week number of the first epoch in the file's own week counter.

SECONDS_OF_WEEK.description: Seconds of week of the first epoch.

MODIFIED_JULIAN_DAY_START.description: Modified Julian Day of the first epoch.

FRACTIONAL_DAY.description: Fractional day of the first epoch.

NUMBER_OF_EPOCHS.description: Number of epochs declared in the header.

SATELLITE_ACCURACY_EXPONENTS.description:
Per-satellite accuracy exponents, parallel to SATELLITE_IDS. The accuracy
is POSITION_VELOCITY_BASE raised to this power.

POSITION_VELOCITY_BASE.description:
Base for the position and velocity standard-deviation exponents carried
per state in $OEM.

CLOCK_RATE_BASE.description: Base for the clock bias and clock rate standard-deviation exponents.

COMMENT.description: Header comment lines in file order.

NCDScenarioEpochContainer.description: Parameters of a scenario-epoch text container.

SCENARIO_EPOCH.description: Epoch that every record offset is measured from, ISO 8601.

TIME_SYSTEM.description: Time scale the scenario epoch is expressed in.

DISTANCE_UNIT.description: Distance unit of the records, e.g. "Meters", "Kilometers".

COORDINATE_SYSTEM.description: Named coordinate system of the records.

COORDINATE_AXES.description: Named coordinate axes, when stated separately from the system.

INTERPOLATION_SAMPLES_M1.description:
Interpolation order expressed as (samples - 1), which is how these
containers state it. Carried verbatim rather than converted, so a rewrite
reproduces the source exactly.

NUMBER_OF_EPHEMERIS_POINTS.description: Number of ephemeris points declared in the container.

SEGMENT_BOUNDARY_TIMES.description: Segment boundary offsets in seconds from SCENARIO_EPOCH, when present.

NCDCode500Header.description: Header words of a fixed-record binary ephemeris container.

SATELLITE_NAME.description: Object name as recorded in the header.

EPOCH_STEP_SECONDS.description: Uniform step between data records, seconds.

HEADER_WORDS.description:
The header record's packed words in file order, undecoded. A reader that
understands a word decodes it; a rewriter reproduces the record exactly
without having to.

NCD.description:
Native Container Descriptor.

The file-level facts of an ephemeris, attitude or tracking container that
are NOT properties of the messages inside it. $OEM, $AEM and $TDM carry the
states, attitudes and observations; none of them can carry the internal
file name, the comment area, the segment address ranges, the header accuracy
block or the interpolation order the source declared, because those describe
the CONTAINER. Without them a read-then-write cycle silently invents header
values, and a segmented binary file cannot be reproduced at all.

ONE record covers every container class rather than one record per format:
the file-level facts are the same kind of fact in each, and the
format-specific blocks are optional sub-tables selected by FORMAT. Only the
block matching FORMAT is populated.

SPK_DAF.description: Double-precision Array File container carrying Spacecraft and Planet Kernel segments: a binary file of typed, independently addressed ephemeris segments, each with an integer target and centre, an integer reference frame, a numeric segment type, and a contiguous address range inside the file.

SP3_C.description: SP3 version c: fixed-column text container of per-epoch satellite positions and optional velocities with a clock column, a header block of accuracy codes, and one uniform epoch interval.

SP3_D.description: SP3 version d: as SP3_C, with an unbounded satellite count and extended header lines.

CODE_500.description: Code-500 fixed-record binary ephemeris: a header record of packed words followed by fixed-length data records on a uniform step.

SCENARIO_EPOCH_EPHEMERIS_TEXT.description: Scenario-epoch ephemeris text container: time-ordered position and velocity records whose epochs are offsets in seconds from a declared scenario epoch, qualified by a named coordinate system, a distance unit, a named interpolation method and an interpolation order.

SCENARIO_EPOCH_ATTITUDE_TEXT.description: Scenario-epoch attitude text container: the attitude counterpart of SCENARIO_EPOCH_EPHEMERIS_TEXT, carrying quaternion, Euler or angular velocity records against the same scenario epoch.

CCSDS_OEM_KVN.description: CCSDS Orbit Ephemeris Message, keyword-value notation.

CCSDS_AEM_KVN.description: CCSDS Attitude Ephemeris Message, keyword-value notation.

CCSDS_TDM_KVN.description: CCSDS Tracking Data Message, keyword-value notation.

PROVIDER_DEFINED.description: A container outside this roster. PROVIDER_DEFINED_FORMAT_NAME states which; a producer never reuses a neighbouring member instead.

PROVIDER_DEFINED_FORMAT_NAME.description: Format name when FORMAT is PROVIDER_DEFINED. Empty otherwise.

FORMAT_VERSION.description: Version of the container format as declared by the file itself.

PRODUCER.description: Producing system or organization as recorded IN THE FILE.

CREATION_DATE.description: Creation date recorded in the file, ISO 8601.

INTERNAL_FILE_NAME.description:
Container-internal file name, which is stored inside the file and is
independent of the name on disk.

COMMENT_AREA.description:
Free-text comment area carried inside the container, one entry per line,
in file order.

NATIVE_FRAME_NAME.description:
Reference frame name as the container itself spells it, before any
mapping onto $RFM.

NATIVE_FRAME_ID.description: Integer reference frame code as the container stores it.

NATIVE_TIME_SYSTEM.description:
Time system as the container itself spells it, before any mapping onto
the ratified time-scale vocabulary.

SEGMENTS.description:
Descriptors of the container's segments, in file order. Empty for a
single-span container.

SP3_HEADER.description: Header block when FORMAT is SP3_C or SP3_D.

SCENARIO_CONTAINER.description:
Parameters when FORMAT is SCENARIO_EPOCH_EPHEMERIS_TEXT or
SCENARIO_EPOCH_ATTITUDE_TEXT.

CODE_500_HEADER.description: Header words when FORMAT is CODE_500.

START_TIME.description: Total coverage start across all segments, ISO 8601.

STOP_TIME.description: Total coverage stop across all segments, ISO 8601.

SOURCE_BYTE_LENGTH.description: Length of the described container in bytes.

SOURCE_SHA256.description:
SHA-256 of the described container's exact bytes, lowercase hex. This is
what makes the descriptor checkable: a consumer can prove the descriptor
belongs to the file it holds.

SOURCE_CID.description:
Content identifier of the described container when it is addressed by
content rather than by path.

PRWInit.description:
Propagator initialization request — assigns TLE / OMM / Keplerian /
polynomial inputs to entity handles.

The actual per-entity source record is carried inline as raw bytes
tagged with SOURCE_KIND and, where useful, a SDS file_identifier.
Callers encode `OMM`, `OCM`, or a one-off Keplerian set and pass the
bytes verbatim; the propagator uses SOURCE_KIND to decide how to
consume them.

ENTITY_HANDLES.description: Entity handles to assign results to (same order as SOURCES[]).

SOURCES.description: Per-entity source records, encoded as SDS FlatBuffers.

MU.description: Gravitational parameter of the central body (km^3 / s^2).

RAAN.description: Right ascension of the ascending node (radians).

NORAD_ID.description: NORAD catalog number parsed from the TLE.

OMM.description: Source is an OMM (CCSDS mean elements) FlatBuffer.

TLE.description: Source is a raw TLE line pair (3LE supported via NAME).

PPE.description: Source is a PPE (polynomial ephemeris) FlatBuffer.

KEPLERIAN.description: Source is a single classical Keplerian element set.

BYTES.description: Encoded source record as a FlatBuffer (consumed per KIND).

KEPLERIAN.description: Convenience inline form when KIND == KEPLERIAN.

TLE.description: Convenience inline form when KIND == TLE.

PRWBatchRequest.description:
Batch propagation request — propagate every entity in ENTITY_HANDLES[] to
EPOCH and write the result StateVector stream to OUTPUT_OFFSET in the
shared arena.

EPOCH.description: Target epoch as a Julian date (TIME_SYSTEM is configured on the host).

ENTITY_HANDLES.description: Entity handles to propagate (empty = all initialized entities).

OUTPUT_OFFSET.description: Output buffer offset in the arena where the StateVector stream begins.

MAX_COUNT.description: Maximum entities to process in this call (0 = unbounded).

TARGET_FRAME.description:
Target reference frame for the output state stream. Matches enum
values in SDS `RFM`. If zero, the propagator chooses its native frame.

PRWBatchResponse.description:
Batch propagation response header — describes the stream written to
OUTPUT_OFFSET and reports errors. The stream itself is
`STATE_VECTOR_SIZE`-tuple rows in the SDS `OCM` STATE_DATA layout.

OUTPUT_OFFSET.description: Offset in the arena where the state-vector stream begins.

STATE_VECTOR_SIZE.description: Components per state vector (6 = PV, 9 = PVA). Mirrors OCM.STATE_VECTOR_SIZE.

REFERENCE_FRAME.description: Reference frame for the stream (SDS `RFM`-compatible string tag).

FLAGS.description: Per-entity status flags (same cardinality as COUNT).

UNKNOWN_ENTITY.description: One or more entity handles not found.

INVALID_EPOCH.description: Invalid epoch (NaN, out of range, before earliest init epoch, etc.).

OUTPUT_BUFFER_OVERFLOW.description: Output buffer too small for the requested count.

ERROR_MESSAGE.description: Optional error message when ERROR_CODE != OK.

PRWInstance.description: Instance identity is host-provided, opaque, and not a physical quantity.

GENERATION.description: Incremented on reinitialization or configuration invalidation.

PRWIntegratorSettings.description: Units are SI. A scalar legacy tolerance must be expanded by the adapter.

ABSOLUTE_TOLERANCES.description: Six or seven positive tolerances, respectively m, m/s and optional kg.

PRWSpaceWeather.description: Instantaneous space weather. TIM epoch is UTC; flux in SFU (1e-22 W/m2/Hz).

AP_INDEX.description: Conventional daily Ap and three-hour Kp index values; not accelerations.

PRWForceConfiguration.description:
Executable subset currently reachable through HPOP invoke. No implied
support for coefficients, drag models or bodies the provider cannot supply.

GRAVITATIONAL_PARAMETER.description: m3/s2; required positive when a central gravity term is enabled.

MAXIMUM_DEGREE.description: Optional truncations; absent selects the explicitly reported model default.

HAS_MAXIMUM_DEGREE.description: True when MAXIMUM_DEGREE carries a value; false means absent.

HAS_MAXIMUM_ORDER.description: True when MAXIMUM_ORDER carries a value; false means absent.

THIRD_BODY_IDS.description: NAIF IDs; explicit vector, e.g. [10,301]. Empty means no third bodies.

EPHEMERIS_SOURCE.description: Actual configured source name, e.g. an analytic series or a planetary SPK kernel.

PRWStateMatrix.description:
Row-major square matrix on [x,y,z,vx,vy,vz,(mass)], SI state units.
Covariance entries have row*column units; STM entries row/column units.

PRWResidentState.description: Identity/state at one epoch. FRM state is m/m/s with named frame/time scale.

MASS_KG.description: Optional initial dynamical mass in kg; distinct from a missing mass.

HAS_MASS_KG.description: True when MASS_KG carries a value; false means absent.

DRAG_AREA_OVER_MASS_M2_KG.description:
Explicit SI concepts Cd*A/m and Cr*A/m. Do not infer these from legacy
ignored/underspecified coefficients; require a caller-provided mapping.

HAS_DRAG_AREA_OVER_MASS_M2_KG.description: True when DRAG_AREA_OVER_MASS_M2_KG carries a value; false means absent.

HAS_SRP_AREA_OVER_MASS_M2_KG.description: True when SRP_AREA_OVER_MASS_M2_KG carries a value; false means absent.

PRWImpulse.description: Impulsive change at TDB epoch; delta velocity is m/s in the named basis.

PRWThrottlePoint.description: Piecewise-linear throttle. Clock is seconds from initial propagation epoch.

PRWBurnBoundary.description: Scheduled time gates an optional condition. At least one must be present.

HAS_ELAPSED_SECONDS.description: True when ELAPSED_SECONDS carries a value; false means absent.

CONDITION.description: SI PCE predicate; direction and goal tolerance explicitly populated.

PRWFiniteBurn.description:
Finite thrust. RTN=(rhat, N cross rhat, N), N=unit(r cross v).
VNC=(vhat, unit(r cross v), vhat cross unit(r cross v)).

HAS_FORCE_NEWTONS.description: True when FORCE_NEWTONS carries a value; false means absent.

HAS_ACCELERATION_M_S2.description: True when ACCELERATION_M_S2 carries a value; false means absent.

DIRECTION.description: Dimensionless components; normalized after adding elapsed*time rate.

DIRECTION_RATE.description: Direction-component change per second, not radians/second.

PRWExecutionRequest.description: Fixed endpoint propagation. Provider selected by the host's connected port.

INCLUDE_MASS_DYNAMICS.description: Explicitly selects 7-state integration even if FINITE_BURNS is empty.

PRWBurnReport.description: Burn times absent until reached; zero means an actual edge at initial epoch.

HAS_START_SECONDS.description: True when START_SECONDS carries a value; false means absent.

HAS_STOP_SECONDS.description: True when STOP_SECONDS carries a value; false means absent.

DELTA_V_M_S.description: Integral of thrust acceleration magnitude, m/s; not vector net delta-v.

STM.description: Both STMs cumulative from request initial epoch; SI state units.

PRWResidentRequest.description: Portable batch request: no output pointer; state records returned via TAB.

PRWPrepareRequest.description: All epochs explicit; duration seconds >=0; empty handles means all resident.

PROFILE.description: Provider-advertised profile name; unrecognized nonempty values fail.

MAXIMUM_POSITION_ERROR_M.description: SI metres and metres/second; absent when UNMEASURED.

HAS_MAXIMUM_POSITION_ERROR_M.description: True when MAXIMUM_POSITION_ERROR_M carries a value; false means absent.

HAS_MAXIMUM_VELOCITY_ERROR_M_S.description: True when MAXIMUM_VELOCITY_ERROR_M_S carries a value; false means absent.

PRWTrajectorySource.description: Existing PPE retains km/km/s, midpoint/time-system and coefficient meaning.

SEGMENT_QUALITY.description: One quality record per PPE.POSITION_RECORDS entry, same order.

SOURCE_OFFSET.description: Chunking indexes SOURCES; no partial polynomial coefficient vector.

PRWNativeInput.description: Native container bytes wholly inside the FlatBuffer; not an NCD trailer.

CONTENT.description: Exactly DESCRIPTOR.SOURCE_BYTE_LENGTH bytes; verify declared hash.

PRWEphemerisRequest.description: Geometric SPK state query, TDB; NAIF IDs state origin and target explicitly.

STATE.description: Explicit ICRF axes and named NAIF origin; FRM state in SI m/m/s.

PRWAtmosphereRequest.description: Diagnostic atmosphere request; UTC instant replaces ambiguous DOY/year=0.

LOCAL_SOLAR_TIME_HOURS.description: Optional local solar time; hours [0,24); absent derives from UTC/longitude.

HAS_LOCAL_SOLAR_TIME_HOURS.description: True when LOCAL_SOLAR_TIME_HOURS carries a value; false means absent.

HAS_TEMPERATURE_K.description: True when TEMPERATURE_K carries a value; false means absent.

HAS_EXOSPHERIC_TEMPERATURE_K.description: True when EXOSPHERIC_TEMPERATURE_K carries a value; false means absent.

HAS_SCALE_HEIGHT_M.description: True when SCALE_HEIGHT_M carries a value; false means absent.

PRWVersionResult.description: Runtime diagnostic version; PLG remains the authoritative manifest identity.

PRW.description: Exactly one arm per envelope. Existing three arms keep their ordinals.

EXECUTION_REQUEST.description: Appended portable arms; each method names its permitted arm.
